howtos.title: Audit your agent skills with two models, apply only shared edits
howtos.what: A skill audit: rival models review your skills read-only, and you apply only the edits they agree on.
copy: Have them run read-only audits of your skills, one with Gemini 4 Neon and one with Fable 5.2, on xhigh effort.
Apply only the edits the models agree on, highest confidence first.
Run this every time a new model drops.
howtos.whenToUse: When a new model ships and your agent skills may be out of date.
